name: Thief
fantasy: The cutpurse duelist. Sticks to one mark, flips past them, never lets go.

card.loop: Keep hitting one target to stack Marks. Vault primes your next hit; land it and Vault resets. Five Marks: Jackpot.
card.dash: A quick flip and a burst of speed. Your next hit is Primed; land it and Vault comes straight back.
card.passive: Hits Mark the target: +8% damage per Mark, up to 5. The fifth Mark pays out Jackpot. Knocks heal you.
card.rmb: Grounds the first foe it wraps, then flies on; catch a second and both are stunned.
card.e: Throw a dagger that sticks to a foe or a wall; recast (or wait) to step to it.

weapons.twin_blades: Quick 3-hit combo; hold for a spin. Every hit Marks the target.

passive.name: Marks
passive.desc: Every weapon hit puts a Mark on the target (one per 0.3s, up to 5, each lasting 4s and refreshed by the next): your weapon hits on them deal +8% per Mark. A Primed hit adds 2, the Bola 1. The fifth Mark pays out Jackpot (below). A knock heals you 15% of your health on top of the usual knock heal (25% in all); an assist heals 25%.

jackpot.name: Jackpot
jackpot.desc: Landing the fifth Mark on a foe releases a burst of 4 knives at them over 0.45s (4.5 each, in sight within 14m). Every knife refreshes all your Marks, and you get one free Vault for 4s. Then it rests 8s.

dash.name: Vault
dash.desc: A 3.4m flip (shots pass through it) and +30% speed until your next hit (2s at most). Your next weapon hit within 3s is Primed: +10 damage, 2 Marks and Shred (+15% damage taken for 3s). Landing it resets Vault.

variants.tap: Throw a spinning Bola 10m: 6 damage and a Mark; the first foe it wraps is Grounded for 1.5s (no dash, jump or glide; slowed 25%) and the Bola flies on 5m. If it catches a second foe, both are stunned 0.9 and take +13 (TANGLED).
variants.air: Thrown from the air the same way.

e.name: Shadow Knife
e.desc: Throw a dagger 12m that sticks in the first foe (8 damage, slowed 50% for 2.5s) or in a wall or the ground where it stops. Press E again to step to it at once; after 5s you step to it anyway.

rank3.sec: flies 1m further after the first foe, and two foes caught pool their Marks
rank3.dash: Primed hits +20%, and a Shadow Knife that sticks in a foe resets Vault
rank3.kin: sticking refunds 25% of the cooldown (50% in a foe)

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 12s -> 9.6s, damage +30%; flies 1m further after the first foe, and two foes caught pool their Marks.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 18s -> 14.4s, damage +30%; sticking refunds 25% of the cooldown (50% in a foe).
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 6.5s -> 4.6s; Primed hits +20%, and a Shadow Knife that sticks in a foe resets Vault.

tells.half: gold Mark diamonds over the target, one per stack
tells.full: five diamonds spinning fast with a coin jingle; a gold blade glint while Primed
tells.dash_spent: a smoke afterimage, dash pip dark
